desc: Run and verify the implementation against supplied examples and targeted edge cases.
Implement prefix range reduction using `count_up_to(r) - count_up_to(l - 1)`.
Implement memoized digit DP for each target digit sum from 1 through 81.
Handle leading zeroes, started-state tracking, and zeroes after the number starts.
Prune impossible digit sums and accept only terminal states with the required sum and divisible product.
